study_title: Transcriptional responses of cancer cells to heat shock-inducing stimuli involve amplification of robust HSF1 binding
description: Illumina HiSeq 4000 sequencing: GSM6383323: MCF7 ATAC As rep2 Homo sapiens ATAC-seq
library_construction_protocol: Fresh cells were subjected to ATAC library construction protocol ATAC-seq was done using the original protocol and buffer {Buenrostro et al., 2013, #304248}.
